name: Lunar occluded sunlight

original_specification.name: Lunar occluded sunlight
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for hardware behind a lander or terrain obstruction.
use_cases: Hardware behind a lander or terrain obstruction
original_specification.sources: Existing single sun and passive surrounding geometry
original_specification.geometry: Real occluder and receiving surface are required
original_specification.contribution_policy: No rig fill; only valid reflected paths illuminate shadow
original_specification.authoring_method: Original lunar authoring concept. Solar directions and relative contributions are illustrative inputs, not site ephemerides or measured lunar photometry. No atmospheric sky, haze or automatic ambient fill is permitted in physical mode.
validation: Shadow detail is not rescued with hidden ambient illumination

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Vacuum mode: no atmospheric sky, fog, star dome or undeclared ambient light.
Solar direction and radiance are authored relative values, not site ephemerides or measured lunar photometry.
